title: The counit mate in tensor-section coordinates equals module base change
statement: Fix scheme Zariski-etale module contexts c and a family e of sheaf isomorphisms from extension of each quasi-coherent module to its tensor-section sheaf [lem-trf-etale-extension-free-presentations-hom]. Assume e is linear, natural in module maps, and identifies the extension unit on opens with the identity. For any scheme morphism a:U→T, a right-adjoint proof hp for the small-etale direct image, and an open-normalized right-adjoint square r, let H be quasi-coherent with quasi-coherent a_*H. For each etale test V→T, conjugating the section component of the counit mate zariskiEtalePushforwardComparison by e_T(a_*H) and e_U(H) equals the global-section component of the canonical moduleBaseChangeMap for the square V×_T U [def-sfb-module-base-change-map]. No invertibility of this map is asserted.

proof.text: Transpose the counit mate using the composite extension/restriction adjunctions. The conjugate-iso unit equation and normalization of r identify its transpose with pushforward of the extension unit. The open-unit condition for e identifies its value on an open section s with 1 tensor s.

On local tensor generators b tensor s, linearity gives the map b tensor s ↦ a_V-sharp(b) times v-prime-pullback(s). The degree-zero adjoint formula for the canonical module base-change map gives the same expression. Restriction functoriality and the normalized pullback composition make these formulas commute with maps of test schemes. Sheafification extends equality from these local generators to all sections, giving the displayed equation.

theorem zariskiEtale_pushforward_section_formula
    (c : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}, ZariskiEtaleModuleContext T)
    (e : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (F : T.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent],
          (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (smallEtaleModuleRing T)).obj ((c T).extension.obj F) ≅
            etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F)
    (hlinear : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (F : T.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
            (V : T.Etale) (b : Γ(V.left, ⊤))
            (s : ((c T).extension.obj F).val.obj (op V)),
          (e T F).hom.hom.app (op V) (b • s) =
            b • (@id (Γ((tensorPullback V.hom).obj F, ⊤))
              ((e T F).hom.hom.app (op V) s)))
    (hnatural : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (F K : T.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [K.IsQuasicoherent]
            (h : F ⟶ K) (V : T.Etale),
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (smallEtaleModuleRing T)).map
            ((c T).extension.map h)).hom.app (op V) ≫ (e T K).hom.hom.app (op V) =
              (e T F).hom.hom.app (op V) ≫ ((tensorPullback V.hom).map h).app ⊤)
    (hopen : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (F : T.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (W : T.Opens),
          ((c T).adjunction.unit.app F).app W ≫
              (e T F).hom.hom.app (op ((AlgebraicGeometry.gabberOpenEtale T).obj W)) ≫
                (tensorOpenSectionIso T F W).hom = 𝟙 _)
    {U T : Scheme.{u}} (a : U ⟶ T)
    (hp : (smallEtaleModulePushforward a).IsRightAdjoint)
    (r : smallEtaleModulePushforward a ⋙ (c T).restriction ≅
      (c U).restriction ⋙ pushforward a)
    (hr : ∀ (G : SmallEtaleModules U) (W : T.Opens),
      (r.hom.app G).app W =
        G.val.presheaf.map (AlgebraicGeometry.gabberPreimageEtaleIso a W).hom.op)
    (H : U.Modules) [H.IsQuasicoherent] [((pushforward a).obj H).IsQuasicoherent]
    (V : T.Etale) :
    (e T ((pushforward a).obj H)).inv.hom.app (op V) ≫
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (smallEtaleModuleRing T)).map
          (zariskiEtalePushforwardComparison a (c U) (c T) hp r H)).hom.app (op V) ≫
        (e U H).hom.hom.app (op (a.Etale.obj V)) =
      (moduleBaseChangeMap a (pullback.fst V.hom a) V.hom
        (pullback.snd V.hom a) pullback.condition.symm H).app ⊤
